meta.title: 焦段怎么选，一组照片才好看
meta.title_en: Pick Focal Lengths So a Photo Set Tells a Story

scenes.context: 单看每张都很好看，但放一起感觉都差不多——因为拍摄时就没挪过地方，焦段一直没换。
sentences: Each photo is fine, but the set feels flat.
paraphrase: Each photo is fine, but the set feels flat.
scenes.speak: Each photo is fine, but the set feels flat. The focal length never changed.

scenes.context: 视角单一，拍再多也都一样，每张照片都在重复同一件事。
sentences: 视角单一拍多少都一样。
Every shot repeats the same thing.
paraphrase: Every shot repeats the same thing.
scenes.speak: One viewpoint repeats itself. Every shot repeats the same thing.

scenes.context: 站远一点拍第一张，把咖啡馆或书店的环境带进去，别人一眼就知道你今天在哪。
sentences: People instantly see where you are.
paraphrase: People instantly see where you are.
scenes.speak: First, capture the environment. People instantly see where you are.

scenes.context: 走近一点换焦段拍人，人和环境都能看清，这种照片最适合发朋友圈。
sentences: Move closer and shoot the person.
Both person and place are visible.
paraphrase: Move closer and shoot the person.
Both person and place are visible.
scenes.speak: Move closer and shoot the person. Both person and place are visible.

scenes.context: 再近一点拍表情，背景少了大家第一眼就看到你的表情，想拍人的状态这组特别合适。
scenes.speak: Closer still, shoot the expression. Less background, more face.

scenes.context: 不用拍脸，拍茶、拍手、拍书、拍窗边，这些不起眼的细节反而最容易让你回想今天。
sentences: Shoot the tea, the hands, the book.
paraphrase: Shoot the tea, the hands, the book.
scenes.speak: Shoot the tea, the hands, the book. Details bring back memories best.

scenes.context: 不用带很多镜头，记住四步：远拍环境、近拍人物、再近拍表情、最后拍细节。
sentences: Four steps are all you need.
paraphrase: Four steps are all you need.
scenes.speak: Four steps are all you need. Wide, close, closer, detail.

scenes.context: 有故事的照片不是每一张都精彩，而是每一张都在告诉别人一点新的东西，合起来才是完整的故事。
sentences: Together they tell the whole story.
paraphrase: Together they tell the whole story.
scenes.speak: Each shot adds something new. Together they tell the whole story.

practice: Each photo is fine, but the set feels flat.
